what: A camera-viewfinder-style first loader — the four corner brackets of the screen tighten with progress into a box around the thin center bar (bar width 1.41 × .87 times), the bar fills from the left, and the % number at bottom right turns like an odometer wheel (each digit rolls only during the last 40% to the next number, and the upper digit follows as far as the lower digit passes 9). The value fills with a .3~.8s (.3 + .9 × share risen) smootherstep pulse whenever the target rises, and the next pulse starts only after one pulse ends. At 100%, .1s later the brackets snap in 5px over .34s, the text lines slide up over .42s cubic-bezier(.7,0,.84,0), then .45s later the board flashes white (leaving only the bar) and .2s later it disappears over .45s — the name line, ISO/aperture/shutter line and focus dot are children supplied by the consuming side

options.min: Minimum seconds to reach 100% (the last share fills at this time), default 2.2
options.hold: Seconds to hold at 100% before releasing, default .1
options.auto: If false, ignores document readiness and follows only fx:progress (detail 0~1), default true

events.fx:progress: Input — detail carries a 0 to 1 progress value (the largest value wins)
events.fx:loaded: Sent — when it reaches 100% and the brackets snap shut
events.fx:done: Send — when the panel flashes (the next scene’s first movement starts here)
events.fx:gone: Sent — after the board has fully cleared

note: Panel colors are --kf-contrast-bg·--kf-contrast-ink, and the flash is --fx-flash (default --kf-raised). The original split progress into file download (.6), fonts (.04), scene building (.18) and finishing (.12). Here the same shares are filled by document load·font ready·min seconds. When flashing, the original moves the bar to the bar position inside the 3D scene, but that belongs to the scene, so it was left out.
